def within_problem(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64).copy()
    for g in np.unique(groups_dev):
        m = groups_dev == g
        x[m] -= x[m].mean(axis=0)
    return x

failure_len = failure - loglen * (loglen @ failure) / (loglen @ loglen)
repeat = within_problem(np.array([r["repeat4"] for r in dev_records]))
repeat_len = repeat - loglen * (loglen @ repeat) / (loglen @ loglen)

    corr = (failure_len @ Xl) / (np.linalg.norm(failure_len) * sd)
    rawcorr = (failure @ Xc) / (

    repcorr = (repeat_len @ Xl) / (np.linalg.norm(repeat_len) * sd + 1e-20)
    D = load_original(f"model.layers.{layer}.mlp.down_proj.weight").numpy()

    top = int(np.argmax(corr))

import ast
from fractions import Fraction

with open("/work/notes.md", "a") as f:
    f.write(
        "\n## Pass 2 input-format failure (consumed)\n"
        "- texts_file was rejected without cost. Passing a path in texts was "
        "incorrectly interpreted as 28 one-character texts, consuming pass 2.\n"
        "- Intended 544-text localization batch was NOT run.\n"
        "- No token-local math claims will be made from fwd_2 outputs.\n"
        "- Remaining plan: two full paired DEV tests at different strengths, "
        "then freeze and test HOLDOUT.\n"
    )

def safe_number(expr):
    expr = expr.strip().rstrip(".,")
    if not expr or len(expr) > 180 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9\s.+*/()\-]+", expr):
        return None
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(expr, mode="eval")
        def rec(node, depth=0):
            if depth > 18:
                raise ValueError()
            if isinstance(node, ast.Expression):
                return rec(node.body, depth+1)
            if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and type(node.value) in (int, float):
                if abs(node.value) > 1e10:
                    raise ValueError()
                return Fraction(str(node.value))
            if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.UAdd, ast.USub)):
                val = rec(node.operand, depth+1)
                return -val if isinstance(node.op, ast.USub) else val
            if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp):
                a, b = rec(node.left, depth+1), rec(node.right, depth+1)
                if isinstance(node.op, ast.Add): v = a+b
                elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Sub): v = a-b
                elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Mult): v = a*b
                elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Div): v = a/b
                elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Pow):
                    if b.denominator != 1 or abs(b) > 8: raise ValueError()
                    v = a ** int(b)
                else: raise ValueError()
                if abs(v.numerator) > 10**30 or v.denominator > 10**30:
                    raise ValueError()
                return v
            raise ValueError()
        return rec(tree)
    except Exception:
        return None

def numeric_equalities(text):
    spans = re.findall(r"\$\$([\s\S]*?)\$\$|\$([^$\n]+)\$", text)
    checked = []
    for pair in spans:
        s = pair[0] or pair[1]
        s = re.sub(r"\\(?:left|right|displaystyle|,|!|;)", "", s)
        s = s.replace(r"\times", "*").replace(r"\cdot", "*").replace(r"\div", "/")
        for _ in range(5):
            s2 = re.sub(r"\\(?:dfrac|frac)\{([^{}]*)\}\{([^{}]*)\}", r"((\1)/(\2))", s)
            if s2 == s: break
            s = s2
        s = s.replace("^", "**").replace("{", "(").replace("}", ")")
        parts = s.split("=")
        for a, b in zip(parts, parts[1:]):
            av, bv = safe_number(a), safe_number(b)
            if av is not None and bv is not None:
                identical = re.sub(r"\s", "", a) == re.sub(r"\s", "", b)
                checked.append((av == bv, identical, a.strip()[:70], b.strip()[:70]))
    return checked

feature_rows = []
for r in dev_records:
    t = r["text"]
    eqs = numeric_equalities(t)
    bad = sum(not e[0] for e in eqs)
    progress = sum(e[0] and not e[1] for e in eqs)
    identities = sum(e[1] for e in eqs)
    L = max(1, len(t))

def remove_controls(x, mask=None):
    if mask is None:

    c = C[mask]
    q, _ = np.linalg.qr(c, mode="reduced")
    z = x[mask]
    return z - q @ (q.T @ z)

def mechanism_summary(rr):
    eq_lists = [numeric_equalities(r["text"]) for r in rr]
    checked = np.array([len(e)>0 for e in eq_lists])
    bad = np.array([any(not v[0] for v in e) for e in eq_lists])
    n_bad = sum(sum(not v[0] for v in e) for e in eq_lists)
    n_valid_progress = sum(sum(v[0] and not v[1] for v in e) for e in eq_lists)
    n_identity = sum(sum(v[1] for v in e) for e in eq_lists)
    result = {
        "answers": len(rr),
        "correct": sum(r["correct"] for r in rr),
        "checked_response_share": float(checked.mean()),
        "response_with_checked_error_share": float(bad.mean()),
        "error_share_among_checked_responses": float(bad.sum()/max(1,checked.sum())),
        "checked_false_equalities": int(n_bad),
        "checked_valid_progress_equalities": int(n_valid_progress),
        "checked_identity_equalities": int(n_identity),
        "median_tokens": float(np.median([r["tokens"] for r in rr])),
        "cut_responses": sum(r["cut"] for r in rr),
    }
    return result, bad, checked
